snippet.title: A Roguelite Dungeon Scroller? | Dark Scrolls | Available Now!
snippet.description:
Start scrolling NOW on PC and Nintendo Switch: https://www.darkscrolls.com/
Call the Hot Scrolls Darkline for tips on unlocking characters you never thought existed - 1 (240) 5WIZARD

This fantasy-themed action platformer fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression and is packed with charm, challenge, and secrets.

Choose from a hefty cast of playable characters - including an axe-throwing warrior, a spell-slinging magician, a knife-hurling thief, or weirder heroes like a cute dog, an alien, or a rat playing a saxophone - and test your skills solo or in local or online co-op.

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
